anchor_semantics.deterministic_selection: minimum hash rank after eligibility, with fixed AA2 salt
anchor_semantics.model_action_adapter: M0/M1 official [0,1] gripper mapping; M2 official raw continuous clip-to-LIBERO mapping
anchor_semantics.noncritical_control: pre-contact candidate with no established grasp, selected separately and never used to define the critical denominator

aa3_fixed_complete_dose_matrix.arm_preservation: command-level OPEN changes only final gripper action coordinate; arm coordinates remain exact within frozen tolerance

branch_validity.invalid_branch_policy: retain in fixed denominator, report separately, and block promotion if any primary branch is invalid

aa4_secondary_blinded_endpoint_audit.reviewer_type: must be explicitly recorded; AI cannot silently satisfy a human-review requirement
aa4_secondary_blinded_endpoint_audit.role: construct-validity/interpretation only; never denominator repair or V_phys relabeling

aa_endpoint_contract.no_endpoint_relabeling: AA labels do not rewrite Stage-Z V_phys, CONTROL_*_ABSTAIN, or historical labels
aa_endpoint_contract.noncritical_control: descriptive phase-control arm; contact=False alone is never a positive endpoint

primary_aa_v_phys.clean_counterfactual_guard: matched clean branch must remain grasp-stable over the same physical horizon; otherwise label AA_NONCAUSAL_TERMINAL_RELEASE or AA_ENDPOINT_AMBIGUOUS, never AA_V_PHYS
primary_aa_v_phys.clean_grasp_precondition: frozen AA2 established grasp plus clean 20-step stable continuation
primary_aa_v_phys.loss_transition: treatment has contact=True immediately before the event, then contact=False for at least two consecutive valid frames
primary_aa_v_phys.open_delivery_precondition: exact native OPEN delivery at the frozen critical anchor for requested T3/T5/T10 steps
primary_aa_v_phys.physical_consequence: during that loss run, support contact remains false and either object z decreases by at least 0.02 m or object displacement versus the matched clean branch is at least 0.01 m
primary_aa_v_phys.window: from first OPEN delivery through T_dose + 10 physical horizon steps

authorization.pi_long_range_goal: Prospective phase-aware fixed-denominator command-level OPEN physical-mechanism replication across M0/M1/M2.

estimand.critical_distinction: The denominator is frozen before any OPEN treatment; treatment endpoint, V_phys, control status, or video label cannot remove a parent.
estimand.definition: Among a clean-only frozen common parent set with an established grasp and a 20-step clean-stable continuation, compare the paired command-OPEN T3/T5/T10 premature-grasp-loss rate for each model family.

population_and_denominator.common_intersection_rule: Run the same clean-only eligibility rule for all three model families; primary eligible parents are the intersection of the three model-specific eligible sets.
population_and_denominator.fixed_denominator_invariant: Once frozen, N is unchanged across T3/T5/T10. Invalid branches are reported separately and cannot trigger post-hoc parent deletion.

freeze_rule.if_common_eligible_24_to_31: freeze all common eligible parents; report exact N
freeze_rule.if_common_eligible_below_24: CAPACITY_LIMIT; no AA3 physical matrix and no replacement/top-up

statistical_promotion_criteria.dose_monotonicity: p_T3 <= p_T5 <= p_T10 at the frozen common denominator
statistical_promotion_criteria.generalization_not_established: same validity requirements, but zero model families satisfy the primary criteria
statistical_promotion_criteria.measurement_or_capacity_limited: N<24, any primary branch invalid, or endpoint audit/construct validity fails; do not convert this to a scientific negative
statistical_promotion_criteria.minimum_effect: absolute paired rate difference p_T10 - p_T3 >= 0.20
statistical_promotion_criteria.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the three model-specific primary T10-versus-T3 paired tests
statistical_promotion_criteria.partial_model_dependent: same validity requirements, but only one or two model families satisfy the primary criteria
statistical_promotion_criteria.phase_specific_secondary: T5 critical rate exceeds T5 noncritical-control rate by at least 0.20 with valid control coverage; otherwise phase-specific promotion is not established
statistical_promotion_criteria.primary_test: one-sided exact paired McNemar test for AA_V_PHYS(T10) > AA_V_PHYS(T3)
statistical_promotion_criteria.replicated_3_of_3: N>=24, 100% primary branch validity, endpoint audit not failed, and all three model families satisfy the primary dose test and dose monotonicity
